sections.content: Plan toolchain-core-skill-replay-portability-and-evaluation-seed preserves the historical 2026-08-01 plan while adding separately owned validation and replay evidence.
sections.title: Scope

sections.content: Provide a repository-relative Skill package validator, bounded capability resolution, fail-closed detached validation, compatibility replay records, append-only evaluation seeds, stable-versus-candidate matrices, workflow-model-routing replay, deterministic rollback, and non-authorizing receipts.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: Preserve historical bytes and lifecycle state. Exclude hosted runtimes, live workspaces, browser or API access, account changes, sandbox changes, installed BMAD or GDS files, active later-phase requirements, autonomous Skill modification, learned ranking, and reinforcement learning.
